source: Geoportal Berlin, Baumbestand (Straßen- und Anlagenbäume), WFS baumbestand; DL-DE-Zero 2.0

estimated.method: crown 0.45 x height (broadleaf) or 0.3 x height (conifer) where the register has none; missing height = median of the species group in this site; ground from the DGM1 1 m cell under the trunk (nearest LoD2 ground heights where it has none)
